description: Parity ledger contract for the bundled-vs-hub answer-leg engine request (specs/artifacts/planning/engine-parity-instrument.md AC-3). Every JSON-path difference between the two captured requests must be listed here with a reason, or the diff fails. Shrinking this list is the refactoring driver.

documented_retrieval_divergence.reason: The two arms assemble context under different policies against the SAME querystore index: bundled's query-scoped QueryStoreChartBuilder ranks records by similarity to the question only, while the hub's context policy additionally applies the provider-neutral context_policy contract (mandatory clinical core + recency anchor for temporal questions, dual-provider-conformance.v1 context.temporal-adds-recency-anchor) — measured 2026-07-22: bundled 30 vs hub 36 records, hub uniquely carrying the entire most-recent (2026-01-28) visit. DELETE this entry once bundled's context assembly implements the same provider-neutral policy; the diff then enforces record-set equality again.

documented_divergences.reason: bundled streams answer tokens to the UI (RemoteLlmEngine inferStreaming); the hub's inner writer call is buffered
accompanies bundled's stream:true (include_usage for token accounting)
hub decodes with explicit anti-repetition settings; bundled relies on server defaults
hub decodes with explicit anti-repetition settings; bundled relies on server defaults
prompt composition is the path under test: bundled sends system(instructions)+user(records+question); hub sends user(records)+user(question)+user(format instructions) with no system role
answer schema family: bundled constrains {answer, citations, reasoning}; hub constrains {answer, blocks, citations}
